decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2016/95-01; 2016/95-02; 2016/95-03; 2016/95-04; Received 09/11/2016.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 59 Kingsley Avenue, Hounslow TW3 4AE and shall not be used as primary residential accommodation, for business purposes or as a separate dwelling.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing garage / utility outbuilding
